workflows.title: Codex Skills sync and catalog governance
workflows.summary: How local skill or plugin changes become durable repository artifacts: inspect the repo instructions, compare local skill homes to the allowlisted suite, decide whether new local work belongs in the curated catalog, regenerate source-backed indexes, review docs-site output, and record drift or blockers before publishing or handoff.

steps.label: Inspect AGENTS.md, README.md, suite metadata, plugin backups, and current git status before changing skill or catalog surfaces
Run the source comparison or catalog artifact check to identify local skill changes, stale repo files, source-only files, or suite allowlist drift
Human operator decides whether new local work should enter the curated public suite, remain local-only, or stay blocked for later review
Regenerate approved catalog artifacts such as skills/INDEX.md, skills/manifest.json, and docs-site/src/lib/catalog.generated.ts
Create evidence by running catalog checks, docs-site build or local server review, and screenshot proof for representative catalog and detail routes
Record the artifact paths, command results, unresolved drift, human review state, and next checkpoint before merge, publish, or handoff
